headlines.description: — Jacob Misiorowski threw six shutout innings to outduel Chris Sale and William Contreras went 4 for 4 as the Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Atlanta Braves 2-1 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Misiorowski outduels Sale and Contreras has big game in Brewers 2-1 victory over Braves

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Alec Bohm tripled to deep center field in the 10th inning Friday night, driving in two runs as the Philadelphia Phillies beat the St. Louis Cardinals 7-6.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bohm's triple in the 10th scores 2 runs as the Phillies beat the Cardinals 7-6

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Rookie Spencer Jones hit a towering two-run homer in the second inning that was upheld on replay, and the New York Yankees beat the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1 on Friday night for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones hits 2-run HR as Yankees beat Blue Jays 3-1 for 5th straight win

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Willson Contreras hit a three-run home run and the Boston Red Sox held off the San Francisco Giants 6-4 on Friday night in the return of...
headlines.shortLinkText: Willson Contreras hits 3-run homer, Red Sox outlast Giants 6-4 in Rafael Devers' return to Fenway

headlines.description: — Javier Sanoja singled through the middle with the bases loaded and no out in the ninth inning to give the Miami Marlins a 3-2 victory over the Washington Nationals on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Javier Sanoja singles with bases loaded in 9th to give the Marlins a 3-2 win over the Nationals

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso hit a go-ahead two-run homer for his 30th of the season, Trevor Rogers struck out six in seven innings and the Baltimore Orioles defeated the AL East-leading Tampa Bay Rays 5-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alonso's 30th homer powers Orioles past Rays 5-3

events.name: New York Mets at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Jake Rogers hit a tiebreaking two-run homer off Jefry Yan with two out in the ninth inning, and the Chicago White Sox topped the New York Mets 6-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Rogers hits a game-ending homer as the White Sox rally past the Mets 6-4

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez doubled twice and drove in two runs to lead the Houston Astros to a 4-0 victory over the Athletics on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: A day after an 18-3 rout, Yordan Alvarez sets the tone in a 4-0 Astros win

events.name: Detroit Tigers at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Vinnie Pasquantino, Kyle Isbel and Carter Jensen all hit solo home runs to power the Kansas City Royals past the Detroit Tigers 5-2 on Friday night for their sixth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Royals use 3 solo homers to power past Tigers 5-2 for a sixth straight win

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Wyatt Langford had a tying RBI double in the 10th inning, then scored the winning run on third baseman Denzer...
headlines.shortLinkText: Scoreless through 9, Rangers beat Angels 2-1 as Langford has tying RBI then scores winner in 10th

headlines.description: — Patrick Bailey and Petey Halpin homered, rookie Travis Bazzana tied a career high with four hits, and the Cleveland Guardians used production from the bottom of their batting order to beat the Colorado Rockies 9-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bazzana, Bailey and Halpin help power the Guardians to a 9-1 win over the Rockies

headlines.description: — Jordan Lawlar hit a two-run homer and had a career-high three RBI, Eduardo Rodriguez threw 5 2/3 strong innings and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Cincinnati Reds 9-0 on Friday night to keep pace in the National League playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Lawlar hits a 2-run HR and has 3 RBIs to lead the Diamondbacks past the Reds 9-0

events.name: Minnesota Twins at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Ty France homered and drove in three runs and Randy Vásquez and two relievers combined on a two-hitter as the San Diego Padres beat the Minnesota Twins 6-2 Friday night in the opener of a three-game series between teams fighting for wild-card berths.
headlines.shortLinkText: France homers, drives in 3 runs as Padres beat Twins 6-2

headlines.description: — Leo Rivas had an RBI single in the 10th inning to give the Seattle Mariners a 6-5 victory over the Chicago Cubs on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leo Rivas has RBI single in 10th, Mariners beat Cubs 6-5

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Tommy Edman singled in the winning run with two strikes in the 10th inning, lifting the Los Angeles Dodgers over the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tommy Edman delivers a 2-strike, 10th-inning walk-off single as the Dodgers edge the Pirates 5-4
